debt.text: In a candidate questionnaire, he said stopping the debt and deficit was necessary to reverse their effect on the cost of living.
debt.quote: The monetary expansion that has occurred due to the debt and deficit has increased the cost of living, and it must be reversed by stopping the debt and deficit.

guns.text: He says no gun-ownership restrictions are needed and identifies himself as fully pro-Second Amendment.
guns.quote: None. I'm 100% pro 2nd Amendment. I have a track record of defending the 2nd Amendment as a Wyoming legislator and will continue protecting the 2nd amendment.

abortion.text: He describes himself as having a fully pro-life record and says he will continue it in Congress.
abortion.quote: I have a 100% pro-life track record and will continue that in Congress.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: As a state representative, he co-sponsored a bill barring transgender girls and women from school sports teams matching their gender identity.
gender.quote: This bill preserves fair competition and an even-playing field.

energy.text: He identifies coal, oil, and gas as reliable energy sources and opposes wind projects and subsidies.
energy.quote: Coal and oil and gas. Woke wind is wrong for Wyoming, and I have worked to STOP wind projects in our state. We must END all subsidies for wind.

tax.text: She supports taxing the wealthy to improve services while lowering taxes for people earning under $100,000.
tax.quote: Taxing the wealthy is another way to improve services to everyone while lowering taxes for those making less than $100,000.

wages.text: She said she would raise the minimum wage.
wages.quote: I would work to remove tariffs, would promote universal healthcare and raise the minimum wage.

trade.text: She says removing tariffs and increasing international trade would help lower living costs.
trade.quote: I feel that removing tariffs and increasing international trade will be the first step to lowering the cost of living for our citizens.

schools.text: She supports public education and restoring federal education programs.
schools.quote: Support the freedom of thought provided by public education, public libraries, public radio and television.

immigration.text: She supports creating legal pathways for immigrants and protections for people including DACA recipients and Dreamers.
immigration.quote: Congress should have met years ago and developed a plan for the people who come to the U.S. to legally start a new life, or were born here, like DACA and Dreamers.

abortion.text: She said she is personally pro-life but supports other people’s choice on abortion.
abortion.quote: pro-life for me,” but “pro-choice for everyone else.

health.text: She supports restoring Affordable Care Act subsidies and working toward universal health care.
health.quote: I want to bring back the ACA subsidies and then work toward Universal Healthcare for All.

energy.text: She supports developing carbon-free geothermal energy while describing it as expensive and compatible with oil and gas expertise.
energy.quote: Next-generation geothermal energy is reliable power which can be built over coal plants, using oil and gas technology and is a carbon-free renewable resource (99% less carbon dioxide than fossil fuels).

tax.text: He said he would lower federal spending and taxes to reduce families’ cost of living.
tax.quote: I would support legislation that puts more money back in the pockets of Wyoming families by reducing federal spending, unnecessary taxes, and regulations that drive up the cost of living.

debt.text: He said he would protect Social Security benefits already earned while allowing younger workers to redirect part of their payroll taxes into individual retirement accounts.
debt.quote: I would also reform Social Security by protecting benefits already earned while giving younger workers the choice to direct a portion of their payroll taxes into individually owned, state-sponsored retirement accounts they can invest and pass on.

immigration.text: He supports border enforcement while also supporting faster legal pathways for needed workers.
immigration.quote: I would secure the border, enforce the laws already on the books, and fix the broken legal immigration system.

abortion.text: He has said that he supports access to abortion.
abortion.quote: Johnson added he supports access to abortion and gay marriage.

health.text: He proposed increasing competition among insurance plans and expanding access to health savings accounts to lower costs.
health.quote: To lower insurance costs, I would increase competition by allowing families to shop for more affordable plans, expand access to health savings accounts, and increase price transparency.

energy.text: He said he would expand energy development and remove barriers that increase costs.
energy.quote: I would expand responsible energy development and remove unnecessary barriers that increase costs.

debt.text: He said the system is under strain and proposed gradually eliminating some Social Security benefits.
debt.quote: With more people living longer it puts a strain on the system. We need to cut back on the bleed by slowly eliminating some of the benefits

safety.text: He said mandatory minimum sentences should be required and enforced for violent crimes.
safety.quote: Mandatory minimum sentencing should be required and enforced for violent crimes.

immigration.text: He called for secure borders and said immigrants should follow the entry process.
immigration.quote: If you are not a terrorist than get in line and take a number.

guns.text: He opposed gun registration while saying people convicted of violent felonies should not have guns.
guns.quote: If you are a felon convicted of a violent crime - no gun. I do not believe in gun registration.

abortion.text: He said he is against abortion, with an exception when continuing the pregnancy would likely kill the mother.
abortion.quote: I am against abortion, but if it comes down to the mother, or the baby, I think the mother should get first choice.

health.text: He opposed a government-run single-payer system and strongly opposed eliminating private health insurance.
health.quote: I am not in support of a government run, single payer healthcare program.
